command: h=$(ls -d /Users/admin/testvm/walk-*/home); f="$h/Library/Application Support/RichOS/.env"; echo 'starter, right after launch:'; stat -f 'mode %Sp size %z' "$f"; shasum -a 256 "$f"; echo "non-comment lines: $(grep -vc '^#' "$f")"; head -3 "$f"

h=$(ls -d /Users/admin/testvm/walk-*/home); sudo launchctl asuser $(id -u admin) sudo -u admin env HOME="$h" security find-generic-password -s com.richos.app.bug-reports -a github-reporting-token >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "reporting token lookup exit $? (44 means no such item)"

sudo -n sh -c 'printf "127.0.0.1 api.github.com
::1 api.github.com
127.0.0.1 github.com
::1 github.com
" >> /etc/hosts' && sudo -n dscacheutil -flushcache && sudo -n killall -HUP mDNSResponder; tail -4 /etc/hosts
if curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null https://api.github.com/; then echo 'api.github.com REACHABLE: stop before any send'; exit 1; else echo 'api.github.com unreachable from the guest, as staged'; fi
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to false'

osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to true'

osascript -e 'tell application "System Events"' -e 'set p to name of first process whose frontmost is true' -e 'if p is not "richos-tauri" then error "frontmost is " & p' -e 'repeat 4 times' -e 'keystroke "=" using {command down}' -e 'delay 1' -e 'end repeat' -e 'return "four Command-= presses sent to " & p' -e 'end tell'
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to true'
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to false'
